params.body:
## What

The Sources page, rebuilt around the reason people open it: a source broke.

- **Needs a look**, first and only when something does: every switched-on source whose last collect failed, with the error in words, how many collects in a row, the adapter, the address and a **Mute** button beside it. Then adapter runs that failed or came back empty, sources the collector parked after 25 failures, and proposals waiting for a yes (the journals openalex-venues needs before it can run).
- **Adapters**: one line each, with the adapter's own description, one status (healthy runs stay grey, only a run that did not do its work is coloured), a bar for new signals in 30 days, cost and its sources. Problems first, then by volume. Opening one shows its facts (road, says it delivers, rests between runs, last delivered, seeds from, needs, cost per run) and its sources.
- **All sources** as tiles that wrap, grouped by adapter, busiest first. A tile's fill is its signals in 30 days in four steps of blue (none, 1 to 9, 10 to 99, 100 to 999, 1,000 or more), with the number on it; trust shows as a word when it is not standard; failing is a red outline. Filter on all, failing, switched off; search by name or address; **Add a feed or page** sits here. A tile opens the source in a side panel (a sheet on a phone) with mute, address, notes, trust, tier and delete.
- **Muting** only flips `active`, so the error stays on the row. **Switching on** clears the error count, the way `/curate/source` does, so a fixed feed is not parked again on its first hiccup.

## Also in here

- **`Button`** (`src/components/ui/Button.jsx`), the first shared component: default, quiet, link, danger, a small size, and `pressed` for a set of choices. Hover, focus and disabled live once in `index.css` under `.btn`; an inline style object cannot have a hover. Every button on this page uses it.
- **The header on a phone.** Its single 48px row made every page about 1,190px wide on a 390px screen, so each page sat in the left third. Below 720px it now wraps onto two lines, and the breadcrumb is hidden there. This touches every page.
- `CollectionStanding.jsx` is gone; its table is now the Adapters card.

## Data

Every number comes from the pipeline. The adapter patterns, `cadence` and `signals30d` arrive with **Trendwolves/gentells-pipeline#307, which has to merge first**. Until it is live, tiles show no fill or number and every source lands under "read by no adapter". The page judges no lateness: how long a silence may last stays with Elixir.

## Checks

- e2e: 32 of 32. The Sources specs are rewritten: a failing source comes first and Mute patches `active: false`; switching on clears the count; search finds a source and its tile opens the panel; adapters list problems first and open onto their facts and sources.
- Lint ratchet: 22 errors, down from 24 (the ceiling is lowered with it); `vite build` passes.
- Looked at on a desktop (1440px) and a phone (390px) against fixture data.
params.title: Sources page: what is broken first, every source at a glance
